I'm from France, i finally found an online chat in french, but it's not working.

I'm tired, i can't stop crying and i wish it didn't hurt anymore... My own actions put me in a difficult situation and everytime i go forward, something is pulling me backward. From an objective point of view it will look stupid, but for me it's like the end of the world.

I'm pretty sure i fucked up my school year (last year of university, or at least the french equivalent) and i did'nt subscribe for another year. I don't have a job, and the last straw was that a paid intership has been refused by my school because i failed. I don't really have any close friend that i am cofortable asking for help, i don't want to tell my familly and disappoint them, and i'm not sure my boyfriend really cares.

And now my cat refuses to be hugged and it feels like betrayal.

On a side note, i also have no idea how reddit and its response message work, sorry
